Residual if a venue returns more than consumed or for tokens sent directly to the helper (no sweep)

externalEntryPoints.route: phUSD -> V2 -> sUSDS -> [redeem USDS] -> [PSM.buyGem floored, USDS dust to recipient] -> [Curve]

externalEntryPoints.function: swapPhUSDToETH(uint256 phusdIn, uint256 minEthOut, address payable recipient, uint256 deadline) returns (uint256)
addLiquiditySUSDS(uint256 susdsDesired, uint256 phusdDesired, uint256 susdsMin, uint256 phusdMin, address recipient, uint256 deadline)
externalEntryPoints.note: requires pair to exist; works on an EMPTY pair (first LP sets price); LP and leftovers to recipient; zero desired amounts not rejected

externalEntryPoints.function: removeLiquiditySUSDS(uint256 liquidity, uint256 susdsMin, uint256 phusdMin, address recipient, uint256 deadline)
externalEntryPoints.pulls: LP from msg.sender directly to the pair (msg.sender must approve the helper on the LP)
externalEntryPoints.note: burns against the pair without Router02; ordering by address comparison sUSDS < phUSD

externalEntryPoints.access: none, NON-view (QuoterV2 reverts internally); intended for eth_call only

externalCalls.notes: Router02 computes the pair via CREATE2 pairFor; with no pair the swap reverts (no code at the computed address)

externalCalls.target: phUSD/sUSDS V2 pair (resolved at call time)
externalCalls.trustLevel: untrusted state (public pair; price manipulable within one block)

externalCalls.notes: last action of swapPhUSDToETH; helper holds no state, so callback can only re-enter stateless entry points

custody.holds: nothing between calls (transient only within a tx). Tokens sent to it directly are stranded (no rescue) unless swept as part of a later call's balance - VERIFIED no whole-balance sweeps exist, every leg uses explicit amounts, so stray tokens stay stranded

trustAssumptions: Every venue consumes exactly the approved amount (otherwise residual allowances persist on a stateless contract)
Mainnet Curve DOLA-3CRV underlying index 2 is USDC (3pool coin order) - not checked on-chain
PSM buyGem pulls exactly floor(g*conv*(WAD+tout)/WAD) (DssLitePsm), matching psmGemForUsds
Users rely on minOut for the whole route; quote functions read spot state and are manipulable intra-block
Non-standard ERC20s out of scope (USDC/DOLA/USDe/USDS/sUSDS/phUSD standard; USDT not used)
